Brand: NODO

NODO is an independent fashion and lifestyle brand positioned between Madrid and Lisbon. Premium daily uniform rather than luxury. Target customer is a creative professional aged 22–34 who values restraint, quality, and cultural relevance over logo visibility or trend-chasing.

Campaign: City Movement Capsule — "In Transit / Between Places / Working From Elsewhere" (name TBC). A capsule about the spaces between work, travel, studio time, and everyday city life. Not a travel campaign. Not a streetwear drop. Deliberately anti-airport, anti-hustle.

Products: Oversized shirts, trousers, knitwear, bags, accessories. Price range EUR 80–220.

Objectives: Sell the capsule, grow email signups, increase cultural relevance in Spain/Portugal/France/Italy, support a potential Madrid or Lisbon pop-up (unconfirmed).

Budget: EUR 3,000–7,000 excluding product.

Timeline: Launch late September. Teaser 2 weeks prior. Follow-up 2 weeks post-launch.

Channels: Instagram (primary), email, TikTok (restrained only), pop-up touchpoints if confirmed.

Audience: Creative professionals, design students, architects, brand workers, startup operators aged 22–34. Based in Madrid, Lisbon, Barcelona, Paris, Milan. Sensitivities: obvious ads, forced scarcity language, fake-deep copy, cringe TikTok tropes, influencer aesthetics.

Constraints: No suitcases. No fake airport shoot. No limited drop language. No real market predictions. No unsupported customer testimonials or UGC claims.

Open questions: Final capsule name, pop-up city, production delay tolerance, email signup incentive.
